    Profile

    A man who fancies himself a jester, Zechs is known as the Veda Templars' "Number Six." He was once a devout believer, but turned his back on the gods upon attaining true power. In his travels through this faded world, he found a king with a soul full of color. He decided they would liven up this land together by creating the finest of theatrical productions.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Male
    Height: 181cm
    Weight: 67kg
    Birthday: Jul 19
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Shimmering Dragon
    Likes: Theater, the King, Mom
    Hobbies: Spreading First-Rate Theater
    Illust: だーくろ（G-ROW）
    CV: 杉田智和
